name: Broad mite damage
symptoms: Distorted or twisted young leaves Leaf curling and thickening Bronzing or darkening of leaf surface Stunted plant growth Cracked or scarred fruits Deformed buds and flowers Young tissues become hard and brittle
description: Broad mite is a microscopic pest that attacks young plant tissues. It feeds on leaves, stems, and fruits by injecting toxic saliva that distorts plant growth. The damage causes severe deformation of leaves and fruits and can significantly reduce crop yield.
management: Regular monitoring of young leaves Remove heavily infested plant parts Improve air circulation between plants Use resistant or tolerant varieties when available Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization
prevention: Inspect seedlings before planting Maintain good greenhouse hygiene Control weeds that may host mites Avoid moving infested plants Monitor regularly during warm humid periods
